scope: Local implementation of slice S2b of docs/QR_3_FAIR_COMPARISON_CONTRACT.md (RC-C33, RC-C44) for PM-1 row F10-02: library-qualification-v2 replaces v1; gate G5 counts exposures of either kind from the shared exposure register (same owner and market, at_ms at or before the run creation time) and gives HOLDOUT_EXPOSED_BY_COMPARISON, with earlier-run reuse taking precedence and an absent or unreadable register or an unaligned holdout start giving HOLDOUT_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_CHECKED. The library reader reads the register inside its READ ONLY transaction whenever the own window and market are readable and discloses exposures as informational flags with ids. The QR-4 eligibility version follows. qualified_total stays 0 (G8).
method: An architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) wrote the S2 design and root accepted D6 and D7. A coder (Sonnet 5.5) wrote S2b; an independent architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reviewed three rounds (round 1 found the disclosure limited to runs that pass G1 to G4); an independent tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran single-edit mutations after each round. A sole-runner tester then ran, with nothing else active, fifteen PostgreSQL files one file per process on a throwaway PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster (quant-library-http 16, gap-branches 7, compare-context 1, g5-register 11, mp-member-set-store 14, mp-member-set 22, quant-research-freeze 22, quant-exposure-register 18, best-inputs-package 26, quant-comparison 19, quant-comparison-create 12, quant-selection 15, quant-selection-register 26, qr2-reader 27, runtime-grants 1; fail 0 and skipped 0 in each), the grant text test and the full unit suite (2120 tests, 0 fail, 6 skipped), plus five single-edit mutations (all killed). Root ruled on every finding. Nobody verified their own work.

result: quant-library-derive 28 of 28, qr4-qualified-selection 54 with 2 todo, qr4-independent 45 of 45 and the PostgreSQL library files (http 16, gap-branches 7, compare-context 1, g5-register 11) pass; engine-hash closures unchanged.

mutations.round3: The denied-SELECT positive control killed in the sole-runner pass.

limits: Deploy order: the exposure register extension and the grant reapply must precede any deployment of this library code; otherwise the library detail and compare views fail closed with a permission error.
The library responses change version string to library-qualification-v2 and gain qualification.exposure and qualification.flags; the UI does not show the flags yet.
The compare view carries G5 but not the informational flags.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the agent reports, the rulings, the sole-runner verification and the final diff and accepted S2b as local engineering evidence for F10-02. Acceptance changes no PM-1 credit by itself and deploys nothing.
